title: Handicap's burger mod
description: New food, tools, weapons, and a whole dimension
body:
This mod add many new features here's some examples!

There's new food items including the basic burger, the bigmac, the chicken sandwich, the salmon sandwich, and more.

There's a new ranged weapon, the burger launcher. The burger launcher is just like the bow in functionality, but instead of arrows it uses basic burgers as ammo.

There's new tools including the tomato pickaxe, the cheese axe, and the tomato destroyer.

There's new blocks like the cheese block which is crafted with nine cheese and gives off a faint glow, or the burger Block which is crafted with 4 basic burgers and is textured like a burger.

There's a new mob, the burger creature! The burger creature is a passive mob that floats around the burger dimension, and drops basic burgers when killed.

So what are you waiting for? Give it a shot!
